caption: A tub of ice cream is taken from the freezer, and a white frost forms on its lid as it sits on the counter.

sa.check: A tub of ice cream is taken from a freezer.
The tub sits on a counter.
A white frost forms on its lid.
The frost grows as a haze on the cold surfaces.
The counter around the tub stays clear of frost.

pc.expect: The frost builds first on the cold surfaces and any later change is toward wetness as the tub warms; it does not come and go.
pc.fail: The frost thickens, goes and thickens again; or the frost turns back to bare dry plastic and then frosts again; or wet drops on the lid turn back into dry white frost while the tub sits in the warm room; or the frost thins and thickens in turn.

pc.expect: The white appears on the tub's own cold surfaces and spreads across them, not on the warm counter or wall.
pc.fail: The frost appears on the counter around the tub while the lid stays bare; or the tub's label changes colour rather than frosting over; or the frost appears on the warm wall behind; or the frost covers the whole scene.

pc.expect: Once the frost turns to drops they run downward on the tub's sides and gather at its base.
pc.fail: A drop runs up the tub's side; or water gathers on top of the lid and stays as a dome; or a drop leaves the tub and rises; or a run travels sideways round the tub and stays level.

pc.expect: The frost is a fine white bloom on the surface that softens into beads as the tub warms, and the tub stays a rigid tub.
pc.fail: The frost stands off as thick spikes of ice; or the frost peels away as a sheet; or the tub's wall flexes as the frost grows; or the frost turns to a hard glaze that stays dry as the tub warms.

pc.expect: One tub with one lid on one counter; the tub keeps its shape and nothing passes through it.
pc.fail: The tub changes shape; or a second tub appears; or the lid passes into the tub; or the tub vanishes.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The tub's label, the counter and the kitchen stay the same.
pc.fail: The label's printing changes; or the counter changes pattern; or items in the kitchen rearrange.
